title: Ants — action (model → engine)
description: One move per ant, positionally aligned with state.mine. LENGTH MUST EQUAL len(state.mine) — a cross-field invariant JSON Schema cannot express, so conformance checks it. A move into water or off a legal square is rejected and that ant holds; a rejection costs a move, never the match.

items.description: N/E/S/W move one cell with wrap; "-" holds position.
